reconcile.note: John Gill reads Joshua's forever as an idiom for a long duration, conceding that Ai was rebuilt and inhabited by the Jews after the Babylonian captivity.

sides.snippet: So Joshua burnt Ai, and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.
sides.verseText: So Joshua burnt Ai, and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

sides.snippet: The men of Bethel and Ai, a hundred twenty-three.
sides.verseText: The men of Bethel and Ai, a hundred twenty-three.
